guide.title: Guide
guide.description: Walks through first-time office setup and the monthly steps in order. Each step takes you to the related screen in one click.
guide.setup.title: First setup
guide.setup.description: Done once. Add taxpayers, connect invoice and bank sources, install the agent on an office computer.
guide.setup.add_taxpayer.title: Add taxpayer
guide.setup.add_taxpayer.body: Enter the tax ID, name and contact email. The taxpayer receives an approval link and appears in the Taxpayers list once approved.
guide.setup.excel_import.title: Import the taxpayer list from Excel
guide.setup.excel_import.body: With many taxpayers, upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file in the Taxpayer list step of the office setup wizard. The Taxpayer invites step emails everyone on the list.
guide.setup.app_invite.title: Invite the taxpayer to the app
guide.setup.app_invite.body: Invites the taxpayer to the taxpayer portal and mobile app to send receipts and documents themselves. The invite screen in the office panel is in progress.
guide.setup.integrator.title: Connect the e-invoice integrator (İşNet, EDM)
guide.setup.integrator.body: Open the taxpayer, choose Connect integrator on the Connections tab and enter the web service user. Use Test connection to check the user is accepted; once the status is Connected, invoices arrive automatically every day.
guide.setup.bank_statement.title: Bank statement
guide.setup.bank_statement.body: Open the taxpayer and upload the statement on the Bank tab. Transactions are matched to invoices and accounts; a balance mismatch shows up as a warning.
guide.setup.vat_threshold.title: VAT threshold
guide.setup.vat_threshold.body: Turn on the VAT watch under Settings → VAT tracking and enter the threshold. When a taxpayer's VAT payable for the month passes it, a "VAT threshold exceeded" warning appears.
guide.setup.desktop_agent.title: What the desktop agent is for
guide.setup.desktop_agent.body: A small program on an office computer. It watches a folder, uploads e-invoices, Luca payroll reports, trial balances and PDFs and matches them to the right taxpayer. It also runs transfers to Luca. Download it for Mac or Windows from this screen.
guide.setup.whatsapp.title: What the WhatsApp extension is for
guide.setup.whatsapp.body: A browser extension for WhatsApp Web. It saves receipts, invoices and documents sent by taxpayers to the right taxpayer as expense, income or document in one click.
guide.monthly.title: Every month
guide.monthly.description: The month close runs in this order. The Next task screen shows which step each taxpayer is on.
guide.monthly.documents.title: Documents arrive
guide.monthly.documents.body: Invoices come from the integrator, statements and receipts from the taxpayer, files from the agent. See missing statements, Z reports, expenses and invoices on Document collection and request them in one click.
guide.monthly.next_task.title: Next task
guide.monthly.next_task.body: Each taxpayer's next close step is here. Open the step; nothing runs without your approval.
guide.monthly.taxpayer_check.title: Check invoices, Z reports, expenses and bank on the taxpayer
guide.monthly.taxpayer_check.body: Open the taxpayer; approve suggestions and fix gaps on the Invoices, Z reports, Expenses and Bank tabs. Everything awaiting approval is also collected in the Inbox of the review queue.
guide.monthly.vat.title: VAT and threshold
guide.monthly.vat.body: The month-end VAT report on Reports shows each taxpayer's sales and purchase VAT, carried-forward VAT and whether a payment is due. Those over the threshold are in Warnings.
guide.monthly.luca_export.title: Transfer file for Luca
guide.monthly.luca_export.body: Open the taxpayer; Transfer to Luca on the Overview page downloads the period's approved entries as a file, which you upload to Luca. Office-wide transfers are on the Journals and transfer screen.
guide.monthly.luca_import.title: Upload the payroll and ledger export from Luca
guide.monthly.luca_import.body: Upload the trial balance from Luca to the taxpayer's Trial balance tab and the payroll report to the Staff and payroll tab. Files dropped in the agent's folder are uploaded automatically.
guide.monthly.close.title: Close
guide.monthly.close.body: The month-end close counters on Next task show how many taxpayers are on which step and how many periods are closed. The period closes once all steps are done.
guide.locked.title: If a document arrives for a locked month
guide.locked.description: When a document for a closed period arrives, a "change request for a locked period" card appears at the top of the taxpayer page and you choose one of three options. All pending late documents are on the Late documents screen.
guide.locked.reject.title: Reject
guide.locked.reject.body: The document is not recorded and the closed period does not change.
guide.locked.correction.title: Record as a correction to the past period
guide.locked.correction.body: The document is recorded in its own month. If that month's return was filed, an amended return may be needed.
guide.locked.apply.title: Apply to the selected month
guide.locked.apply.body: The document is recorded in the open month you choose; the closed period does not change.
guide.returns.title: Tax returns
guide.returns.description: The system does not file returns; it tracks which returns of which taxpayer are ready, filed or paid.
guide.returns.track.title: Track tax returns
guide.returns.track.body: The Tax returns screen shows each taxpayer's VAT and withholding return status. After filing at the tax office portal, upload the accrual and mark it filed.
guide.tour.welcome.title: Welcome
guide.tour.welcome.body: A short tour of the main screens of the office panel. Press Close at any time.
guide.tour.taxpayer_requests: Add taxpayers here. The taxpayer approves through the link in the email.
guide.tour.document_collection: At the start of the month, see missing statements, Z reports, expenses and invoices here and request them in one click.
guide.tour.copilot: Each taxpayer's next close step. Start your day here.
guide.tour.review: All suggestions awaiting approval; the Inbox gathers invoices, bank, expenses and Z reports in one place.
guide.tour.taxpayers: Opening a taxpayer shows the Invoices, Z reports, Expenses, Bank and Trial balance tabs.
guide.tour.journals: The Luca / Zirve file is produced here from approved entries.
guide.tour.tax_returns: Track the status of tax returns here. The system does not file them itself.
guide.tour.agents: Desktop agents on office computers: they upload files from a folder and transfer to Luca.
guide.tour.guide: You will find this tour and all steps on the Guide page. You can restart the tour there.
